items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: It was a guy by the name of Andrew, Andrew Jackson, I think that was the man. Anyway, he waited for the railroad. And the railroad. He put it on a hot, I would be dead. I know that he was head of it.

ctx.x: Then you played, you'd have those special dances at the Royal Rick, or did the organization put the, who hired you to go out? Did some be some lodge, or the railroad? No, no, it wasn't no lodge.
It was a guy by the name of Andrew, Andrew Jackson, I think that was the man. Anyway, he waited for the railroad. And the railroad. He put it on a hot, I would be dead. I know that he was head of it.
I have heard of excursions like say the Elks or something would hire a band when they go to a contention. Yeah, but no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no. Nothing like that.
